svg.title: Three lines of light join at one point
svg.desc: Three lines of light, labelled investors, engineers and research partners, come in from the left edge, the bottom edge and the right edge of the screen and rise toward the full stop at the end of the title. The three lines have met and run on as one into the full stop, which is lit with a ring of light.

text.font-family: Instrument Sans Variable, Instrument Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
